card: A's step/stack motion (BP 4400h / DX 4000h): alternatives with full 64-position coverage (BP = odd multiple of 400h) and trail 400h (BP-DX = 400h).

model.what: Multi-stream crossfire model extending A005 phase-sim: our A (candidate step) + our B (rev0) vs 1 or 3 rev0 teams; random load bands; counts partner/enemy rebuild kills only (no zombies, no other opponents). Swept all 32 odd k (BP=k*400h, DX=BP-400h).
model.results: Baseline 4400h: own-partner kills 0.16-0.20/battle, our share 0.504 (1 enemy team) / 0.250 (3 teams). Best in model: 6C00h (share 0.517/0.277, own kills 0.105), 0F400h (upward C00h; 0.519/0.275), 3400h (0.516/0.275). 2C00h (= B's step) minimizes partner crossfire (0.04) but also kills fewer enemies (neutral share). Model gains were NOT reproduced by the engine (see screens/threat).

candidates.notes: Screen ALL +0.0074 just over the bar but CI wide, 2025 group -0.008; the dedicated 2-copy V6-family threat job (480 battles/arm) is -0.023 with lead_V4 clearly negative and zchain4 -0.065. Best of 3 noisy draws (mean of the 3 step screens -0.010): treat as noise. Not promising.

threatFindings.threat: Partner crossfire (B's trail killing A mid-rebuild) depends on A's step; model says 6C00h/F400h/3400h cut it and help vs V6-family crowds
threatFindings.evidence: msim.mjs predicts +0.012..+0.027 share vs 1-3 V6 teams; engine: screens ryqef/vwr14 lead_V6 -0.09 and smulti-mix -0.06/-0.11; threat asnxm (A_s13 vs V6/V6Guard/V4/zchain4 x2) -0.023 [-0.052,+0.005].

threatFindings.threat: A's step is a sensitive, chaotic parameter: changing it reshuffles per-cohort outcomes by +-0.1 with no systematic gain
threatFindings.evidence: Three full-coverage steps screened: -0.019, -0.017, +0.007 (CI half-widths ~0.025, about 3x the ~1-turn-edit noise seen in A004).

threatFindings.threat: Sharing the 4400h step with V6-family opponents (lockstep relative positions) is a weakness
threatFindings.evidence: Different steps did not improve vs lead_V6/V6Guard/V4/zchain4 (asnxm -0.023; ryqef lead_V6 -0.094; vwr14 lead_V6 -0.089).

recommendation: Do not promote. Keep A's step 4400h/4000h. No full-coverage alternative showed a gain; the abstract crossfire model is not predictive for this parameter. Do not spend more jobs on A's step unless combined with a lattice/family change.
